items.title: Wake up, check out
items.note: Luggage packed the night before; collect the breakfast box from reception.

items.title: K Hotel → Baiyun Airport (白云机场)
items.note: Taxi, ~45 min; usually no traffic early morning. The car booked the night before is used.
items.tip: The car should be booked in the ride-hailing app the night before, to avoid finding none at dawn.

items.title: Check-in, bag drop, security
items.note: ~2 hr 45 min allowed, as for international flights; breakfast at the airport.
items.tip: Since Dec 2024 international check-in at Baiyun closes at most 60 min before departure, and 45 min for some airlines (e.g. China Southern, China Eastern); the airline's notice is final.
